'''Jamie Abel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2000 Ohio State Championship]] on 15 April 2000, according to Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d551">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ columbus-ohio-4-15-00-states], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 18 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ GitHub Pages]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027205111/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-18-columbus-ohio-4-15-00-statesd551/ Internet Archive]</ref>
